item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:50 HKT 27/Nov/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a strong replenishment of the northeast monsoon, temperatures over the coast of Guangdong will drop slightly today and tomorrow. The weather over the region will be cool in the morning, generally fine and very dry during the day, with a rather large temperature difference between day and night. On the other hand, Tropical Cyclone Koto will move across the southern part of the South China Sea today and tomorrow. It will then move in the general direction of the vicinity of Vietnam and the seas south of Hainan Island, and is expected to gradually weaken under the influence of the northeast monsoon. A band of clouds will gradually cover the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of Guangdong during the weekend to early next week. There will be one or two rain patches over the region.
